q: "The Qoryak people live in the northern part of the Kamchatka peninsula which is part of the Russian Federation. They were conquered by the Cossacks at the end of the 1600s and were then incorporated into the Russian empire. However, the tsar mainly left them alone except for he required a fur tribute from all adult males and some transportation services."
